FINAL REPORT DOCUMENTATION

1. INTRODUCTION & PROJECT PLAN
Objectives: To provide a centralized repository for digital learning resources and facilitate student-teacher interaction.
Scope: User authentication, course management, and interactive multimedia lessons.
Schedule: Wk 1: Requirements; Wk 2-3: Design/DB; Wk 4-6: Implementation; Wk 7: Testing/Documentation.

2. REQUIREMENT SPECIFICATION
Audience: Students (primary learners) and Admins (content managers).
Use Cases: [UC1] Register Account, [UC2] View Course, [UC3] Manage Content (Admin).
Flow Chart: Entry -> Login Check -> Dashboard -> Content Selection -> Activity Execution.

3. DESIGN AND MODELING
ERD: Tables include Users (UID, Name, Email, Pwd), Courses (CID, Title, Instructor), and Enrollments (EID, UID, CID).
Wireframes: Clean header with navigation, sidebar for modules, and main content area for multimedia players.
Navigational Structure: Hierarchical (Home > Categories > Course Details > Content).\n
4. IMPLEMENTATION
CSS: External stylesheets handle the grid system and responsive design. Form validation uses ASP.NET validation controls for server-side security and HTML5 attributes for client-side UX. 
SQL Query Example: SELECT * FROM Courses WHERE CategoryID = @CatID;

5. USER GUIDANCE
[Screenshot: Dashboard] - Shows the user's progress and available courses.
[Screenshot: Admin Panel] - Shows the interface for Adding/Deleting courses.

6. CONCLUSIONS
The EduStream system successfully implements all .Net requirements, providing a robust environment for digital learning via CRUD operations and responsive multimedia handling.
